title: Fix Share Night Roster buttons
summary: Repairs the Share Night Roster action wiring so Send Night Roster, Copy link and Installation help respond correctly on supported devices.
changes: Send Night Roster now dispatches through the correct share action channel and opens the device share sheet where supported.
Copy link and Installation help use the same corrected share event path instead of silently doing nothing.
Browser coverage now clicks the real Send Night Roster button and verifies that only the public Night Roster welcome URL is shared.
